description.value:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Whether crafted from genuine szynegator components or synthetic imitations, these grenades mimic some of the effects of the Swarm creature while dealing damage like its acidic blood. Szynegation grenades deal the listed amount of persistent acid damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] Save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, a creature that critically fails its saving throw against a szynegation grenade cannot use electronic or telepathic communication and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled]. These effects last as long as an affected creature is taking persistent acid damage from the grenade.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and the persistent acid damage is 1d8.
